notes:
Toyota e-TNGA battery electric cars: Toyota bZ4X and Subaru Solterra, about 2022 onwards. The Lexus RZ shares the platform but no source opened has a file for it, so it is named here only as untested.

The bus is the OBD socket's ISO 15765-4 CAN, 11-bit identifiers at 500 kbit/s. The units come from two open sources, recorded with their limits in docs/vehicles/japan-korea.md: the OBDb Toyota-bZ4X and Subaru-Solterra repositories (CC-BY-SA-4.0; signalsets and per-model-year response records, taking only the request header, response header and service) and the Open Vehicle Monitoring System's vehicle_toyota_etnga module (MIT), the shared base for its bZ4X and Solterra vehicle types, which says it has been confirmed on a 2022 to 2024 Solterra and not yet tested on a bZ4X or the 2025 and 2026 refresh. Every unit here reads with UDS service 22 in both sources and neither opens a session, so the profile is UDS in the default session; this differs from the toyota-tnga profile, where the ABS and HVAC units on the same identifiers read with service 21.

Left out: the tyre pressure unit on 0x750 with replies on 0x758, reached with the extended-address byte 0x2A, because both sources match its replies on 0x2A where this tool expects the tester address 0xF1 first (issue 63). The Solterra-only rows on 0x746 and 0x7A2, and the 0x7B3 and 0x7C0 units that answered in single response records without a signalset command, because no second source places them. The 2025 bZ4X record lists the plug-in control, battery and hybrid control units as unsupported and the 2026 bZ4X record lists all five, so a refresh car may not reply on these identifiers.

Neither source reads fault codes, so service 19 on these units has no source. Treat every row as unconfirmed until obd-read probe shows the unit answering.
name: toyota-etnga
description: Toyota e-TNGA battery electric cars (bZ4X and Solterra), UDS over ISO-TP

vin.source: The WMIs are the makers' car and SUV identifiers in the world manufacturer identifier table of the Wikipedia article Vehicle identification number, which cites the Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt manufacturer list SV 3.2 (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_identification_number, archived https://web.archive.org/web/20261102120229/https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vehicle_identification_number). A WMI names the maker and plant, not the model, so a match only says the car is of a make this profile covers.

plug-in-control.source: OBDb Toyota-bZ4X signalset (https://github.com/OBDb/Toyota-bZ4X/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150433/https://github.com/OBDb/Toyota-bZ4X/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json) and OBDb Subaru-Solterra signalset (https://github.com/OBDb/Subaru-Solterra/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150456/https://github.com/OBDb/Subaru-Solterra/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json): 0x745 with response 0x74D and service 22 (charge power, control mode and AC charger signals) in both, identical between the two; OVMS vehicle_toyota_etnga.h (https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.h, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150653/https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.h) and vehicle_toyota_etnga.cpp (https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.cpp, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150705/https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.cpp): PLUG_IN_CONTROL_SYSTEM_TX 0x745 and _RX 0x74D, which the module's comments call the OBC and say answers only while charging when it reads the HVAC power, polled with service 22 (VEHICLE_POLL_TYPE_READDATA) and normal addressing (ISOTP_STD). Two sources agree on both identifiers and the service. Not read from a car.

hv-battery.source: OBDb Toyota-bZ4X signalset (https://github.com/OBDb/Toyota-bZ4X/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150433/https://github.com/OBDb/Toyota-bZ4X/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json) and OBDb Subaru-Solterra signalset (https://github.com/OBDb/Subaru-Solterra/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150456/https://github.com/OBDb/Subaru-Solterra/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json): 0x747 with response 0x74F and service 22 (cell voltage, capacity and state of charge signals) in both, identical between the two; OVMS vehicle_toyota_etnga.h (https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.h, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150653/https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.h) and vehicle_toyota_etnga.cpp (https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.cpp, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150705/https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.cpp): HYBRID_BATTERY_SYSTEM_TX 0x747 and _RX 0x74F, polled with service 22 (VEHICLE_POLL_TYPE_READDATA) and normal addressing (ISOTP_STD). Two sources agree on both identifiers and the service. Not read from a car.

abs.description: Brake and electric parking brake unit (ABS, VSC, TRC and EPB)
abs.source: OBDb Toyota-bZ4X signalset (https://github.com/OBDb/Toyota-bZ4X/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150433/https://github.com/OBDb/Toyota-bZ4X/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json) and OBDb Subaru-Solterra signalset (https://github.com/OBDb/Subaru-Solterra/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150456/https://github.com/OBDb/Subaru-Solterra/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json): 0x7B0 with response 0x7B8 and service 22 (master cylinder temperature, parking brake and brake stroke signals) in both, identical between the two; OVMS vehicle_toyota_etnga.h (https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.h, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150653/https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.h) and vehicle_toyota_etnga.cpp (https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.cpp, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150705/https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.cpp): BRAKE_EPB_TX 0x7B0 and _RX 0x7B8, commented as the Brake/EPB ECU (ABS/VSC/TRC and electric parking brake), polled with service 22 (VEHICLE_POLL_TYPE_READDATA) and normal addressing (ISOTP_STD). Two sources agree on both identifiers and the service. Not read from a car.

hvac.source: OBDb Toyota-bZ4X signalset (https://github.com/OBDb/Toyota-bZ4X/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150433/https://github.com/OBDb/Toyota-bZ4X/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json) and OBDb Subaru-Solterra signalset (https://github.com/OBDb/Subaru-Solterra/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150456/https://github.com/OBDb/Subaru-Solterra/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json): 0x7C4 with response 0x7CC and service 22 (cabin and ambient temperature, setpoint and heater signals) in both, identical between the two; OVMS vehicle_toyota_etnga.h (https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.h, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150653/https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.h) and vehicle_toyota_etnga.cpp (https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.cpp, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150705/https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.cpp): AIR_CONDITIONER_TX 0x7C4 and _RX 0x7CC, polled with service 22 (VEHICLE_POLL_TYPE_READDATA) and normal addressing (ISOTP_STD). Two sources agree on both identifiers and the service. Not read from a car.

hybrid-control.description: Hybrid control system (the EV control unit)
hybrid-control.source: OBDb Toyota-bZ4X signalset (https://github.com/OBDb/Toyota-bZ4X/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150433/https://github.com/OBDb/Toyota-bZ4X/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json) and OBDb Subaru-Solterra signalset (https://github.com/OBDb/Subaru-Solterra/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150456/https://github.com/OBDb/Subaru-Solterra/blob/main/signalsets/v3/default.json): 0x7D2 with response 0x7DA and service 22 (odometer, drive mode, transaxle oil temperature and accelerator signals) in both, identical between the two; OVMS vehicle_toyota_etnga.h (https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.h, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150653/https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.h) and vehicle_toyota_etnga.cpp (https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.cpp, snapshot https://web.archive.org/web/20261116150705/https://github.com/openvehicles/Open-Vehicle-Monitoring-System-3/blob/master/vehicle/OVMS.V3/components/vehicle_toyota_etnga/src/vehicle_toyota_etnga.cpp): HYBRID_CONTROL_SYSTEM_TX 0x7D2 and _RX 0x7DA, commented as the EV ECU, polled with service 22 (VEHICLE_POLL_TYPE_READDATA) and normal addressing (ISOTP_STD). Two sources agree on both identifiers and the service. Not read from a car.
